text: Hi! Let's watch a formula make a new number, one step at a time.
Choose a starting number. Then add the same amount every time.
Our rule today is plus... three. Three little lights travel together through the gate.
The number on the left goes in. Add three, and the next number comes out.
Adding the same amount each time makes an arithmetic sequence.
The small label tells us which term we are making. It is different from the value of that term.
Let's begin. Watch the lights, and say each new answer with me.
Two.
Two plus three is... five.
Five plus three is... eight.
Eight plus three is... eleven.
Look back at our fourth term. We started with two and added three three times. Two plus three times... three is eleven. The first term needs zero additions, so term four needs three.
Eleven plus three is... fourteen.
Fourteen plus three is... seventeen.
Seventeen plus three is... twenty.
Twenty plus three is... twenty-three.
Twenty-three plus three is... twenty-six.
Twenty-six plus three is... twenty-nine.
Twenty-nine plus three is... thirty-two.
Thirty-two plus three is... thirty-five.
Thirty-five plus three is... thirty-eight.
Thirty-eight plus three is... forty-one.
Forty-one plus three is... forty-four.
Forty-four plus three is... forty-seven.
Forty-seven plus three is fifty.
Fifty plus three is... fifty-three.
Fifty-three plus three is... fifty-six.
Fifty-six plus three is... fifty-nine.
Fifty-nine plus three is... sixty-two.
Sixty-two plus three is... sixty-five.
Sixty-five plus three is... sixty-eight.
Sixty-eight plus three is... seventy-one.
Seventy-one plus three is... seventy-four.
Seventy-four plus three is... seventy-seven.
Seventy-seven plus three is... eighty.
Eighty plus three is... eighty-three.
Eighty-three plus three is... eighty-six.
Eighty-six plus three is... eighty-nine.
Eighty-nine plus three is... ninety-two.
Ninety-two plus three is... ninety-five.
Ninety-five plus three is... ninety-eight.
Ninety-eight plus three is... one hundred one.

We have crossed one hundred. Ninety-eight plus three is one hundred one. Watch the three new lights: one makes ninety-nine, one makes one hundred, and one makes one hundred one. The jump is still exactly three.
One hundred one plus three is... one hundred four.
One hundred four plus three is... one hundred seven.
One hundred seven plus three is... one hundred ten.
One hundred ten plus three is... one hundred thirteen.
One hundred thirteen plus three is... one hundred sixteen.
One hundred sixteen plus three is... one hundred nineteen.
One hundred nineteen plus three is... one hundred twenty-two.
One hundred twenty-two plus three is... one hundred twenty-five.
One hundred twenty-five plus three is... one hundred twenty-eight.
One hundred twenty-eight plus three is... one hundred thirty-one.
One hundred thirty-one plus three is... one hundred thirty-four.
One hundred thirty-four plus three is... one hundred thirty-seven.
One hundred thirty-seven plus three is... one hundred forty.
One hundred forty plus three is... one hundred forty-three.
One hundred forty-three plus three is... one hundred forty-six.
One hundred forty-six plus three is... one hundred forty-nine.
One hundred forty-nine plus three is... one hundred fifty-two.
We have made fifty-one terms, using fifty additions. Start with two, then add fifty groups of three. Two plus fifty times three is one hundred fifty-two. The same rule keeps working.
One hundred fifty-two plus three is... one hundred fifty-five.
One hundred fifty-five plus three is... one hundred fifty-eight.
One hundred fifty-eight plus three is... one hundred sixty-one.
One hundred sixty-one plus three is... one hundred sixty-four.
One hundred sixty-four plus three is... one hundred sixty-seven.
One hundred sixty-seven plus three is... one hundred seventy.
One hundred seventy plus three is... one hundred seventy-three.
One hundred seventy-three plus three is... one hundred seventy-six.
One hundred seventy-six plus three is... one hundred seventy-nine.
One hundred seventy-nine plus three is... one hundred eighty-two.
One hundred eighty-two plus three is... one hundred eighty-five.
One hundred eighty-five plus three is... one hundred eighty-eight.
One hundred eighty-eight plus three is one hundred ninety-one.

Two hundred ninety-nine plus three is... three hundred two.

Our last term is term one hundred one. There have been one hundred additions. Two plus one hundred times three is three hundred two. One starting value, one fixed difference, and a whole sequence of new numbers.
Two, five, eight, eleven, and on to three hundred two. The difference between neighboring terms was always three.
Change the starting value or the fixed difference, and another arithmetic sequence can begin.
You watched the formula work. Great counting! See you next time.
